[[File:CilparAPC.jpg|220px|thumb|An armored personnel carrier of the [[Cilpari Resistance]].]]
'''Armored personnel carrier''', or '''APC''', was a designation given to a multitude of armored ground vehicles used as [[Troop transport/Legends|troop transports]].<ref name="RB">{{JournalCite|9|Repulsortank Battlefield}}</ref><ref name="RoETRSH">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref><ref name="SoF">''[[Suns of Fortune]]''</ref> They were mostly used by armed forces to ferry troops to the battlefield.<ref name="RoETRSH" /><ref name="RS3RS">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]''</ref><ref name="DN3">''[[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War]]''</ref> In addition, armored personnel carriers could be used by civilian companies to transport their staff in hostile environment. One example was [[Corellia Mining Corporation/Legends|Corellia Mining Corporation]]'s [[A-19 "Iron Crawler" armored transport|A-19 armored transport]].<ref name="SoF" /> Most military APCs were considered "light" vehicles.<ref name="RB" />

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] modified [[A-A5 Speeder Truck/Legends|A-A5 speeder trucks]] to serve as armored personnel carriers.<ref name="A&EG">''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]''</ref> The [[Freerunner/Legends|Freerunner]] was one of the favorite APCs of the [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]].<ref name="RoETRSH" />

Armored personnel carriers were used by the [[Cilpari Resistance]] on [[Cilpar]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. Using tracked wheels rather than [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] technology, it was a low-slung gray-colored vehicle with a dome-like cockpit which had a red viewport. A convoy of these vehicles were used to transport resistance soldiers into [[Mission to Cilpar|battle]] against the local [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Boren Tascl]], with air cover provided by [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]].<ref name="XWRSTRO">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron: The Rebel Opposition]]''</ref> 

Armored personnel carriers were armed vehicles used by the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force]] during their battles with the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] in the [[Swarm War]]. Chiss APCs were armed with [[maser]] cannons fitted to the top of the vehicles. They were deployed against oncoming [[Kolosolok]] forces during the [[Battle of Tenupe]].<ref name="DN3" />
